description: This file contains unit tests for the agent prompt functionality in a chat application, verifying how the conversation entries are processed to generate agent messages, including handling of history, content extraction, and special cases.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Generates a formatted string representing the conversation history with a current message.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatContent
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text from a chat content array, ignoring non-text items like images.

methods.name: buildAgentMessageFromConversationEntries
methods.description: Constructs the agent's message based on conversation entries, prioritizing recent tool output and handling content arrays.
